reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideTargetCategories that all month-wide actions use and parses notes with the existing shared extractTagsFromText rather than a hand-rolled match.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is written once and no existing logic is copied.

placement.why: The rule sits in the single month-wide category selection in budget/actions.ts, documented in its comment.

scope.why: Only the selection query/filter and the corresponding tests change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the selection now mixes SQL filters with a JS post-filter, a small split a maintainer must keep in mind.

one_place.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, the average and last-month actions.
